description_en: Cancels the provisioning configuration for specified public assets. You can use a list of asset IDs or public IP addresses to locate assets. If both are provided, asset IDs take precedence. Upon a successful request, FailedCount includes the number of deduplicated unmatched targets and assets for which the cancellation failed. If only a list of public IP addresses is provided and none of the IP addresses are matched, NotFoundAsset is returned
description_zh: 取消指定公网资产的接入配置。可使用资产 ID 列表或公网 IP 列表定位资产。同时提供时优先使用资产 ID。请求成功时，FailedCount 包含未匹配到的去重目标和取消接入执行失败的资产。仅使用公网 IP 列表且所有 IP 均未匹配时，返回 NotFoundAsset
name: DeleteIdcAssetTraction

parameters.help_en: The list of IDs of the public assets for which you want to cancel provisioning. You must specify at least one of AssetId and IpList. If both are specified, AssetId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 要取消接入的公网资产 ID 列表。AssetId 和 IpList 至少提供一个；同时提供时优先使用 AssetId
parameters.name: asset_id

parameters.help_en: The list of public IP addresses for which you want to cancel provisioning. You must specify at least one of AssetId and IpList. If both are specified, AssetId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh: 要取消接入的公网 IP 地址列表。AssetId 和 IpList 至少提供一个；同时提供时优先使用 AssetId
parameters.name: ip_list

FailedCount.description_en: The number of targets for which provisioning cancellation failed in this request. This includes unmatched asset IDs or public IP addresses, and assets for which the cancellation failed. Duplicate asset IDs or public IP addresses are counted only once. For example, if you submit three different asset IDs, one is unmatched, and the other two are successfully canceled, 1 is returned
FailedCount.description_zh: 本次请求未完成取消接入的目标数量，包括未匹配到的资产 ID 或公网 IP，以及取消接入执行失败的资产。重复的资产 ID 或公网 IP 只计一次。例如，提交 3 个不同的资产 ID，其中 1 个未匹配，其余 2 个均取消接入成功，返回 1

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code. This parameter is empty if the request is successful
ErrorCode.description_zh: 错误码。请求成功时为空

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful
